meta.title: AI Career Assistant
meta.description: See how your CV matches a job posting, with the evidence behind every judgement.

notFound.title: This page does not exist yet

result.sampleNotice: Sample analysis with a fictional CV and job posting.
result.requirementsEmpty: No requirements could be extracted from this job posting. Check that the full posting text was provided, then run the analysis again.
result.sheetEmpty: No evidence statements could be extracted from this CV.
result.fixesEmpty: No changes are suggested for this posting.

questions.title: Interview questions
questions.intro: Questions an interviewer is likely to ask, based on this posting and the gaps above.

questions.empty: No questions were returned for this posting.

progress.title: Comparing your CV with this posting
progress.body: Requirements are extracted from the posting, matched against your CV and checked for evidence. This usually takes under a minute, and the page updates on its own.

failed.title: This analysis could not be completed
failed.body: The AI service did not answer in time or returned an invalid result. Your CV and the posting are saved, so you can run the analysis again.
